details.objective: Activate second-order control over the Repository Improvement Loop without creating a scalar Goodhart target.
details.basis: First Meta Improvement Loop CI observation.

details.conclusion: Current loop friction is dominated by observation-to-change latency rather than verification latency.

details.action: Add a path-aware Critic Router and source-proximate preflight map.
details.mechanism: Map changed files to the cheapest relevant local diagnostics while preserving the full promotion CI gate.
details.anti_goodhart: Preflight PASS never substitutes for promotion verification.

details.deployed_tuning: Critic Router v1 + source-proximate preflight + bounded two-level Meta Improvement Loop

details.lesson: The first meta tuning targets diagnosis/localization because observed loop telemetry showed it dominates downstream verification/promotion latency.
details.effect_claim: NOT_ESTABLISHED until at least three post-tuning RIL cycles are observed.
